title: Marketing Madness: How Brands are Capitalizing on the NCAA’s Biggest Event - BAER PM

facts.fact: The BAER PM article 'Marketing Madness: How Brands are Capitalizing on the NCAA's Biggest Event' was published on March 15, 2024.
According to ESPN, the 2023 men's NCAA tournament final averaged 14.69 million viewers.
facts.quote: According to ESPN, in 2023, the men’s final averaged 14.69 million viewers, and the women’s final averaged 9.92 million viewers

facts.fact: According to ESPN, the 2023 women's NCAA tournament final averaged 9.92 million viewers, an all-time high.
facts.quote: the women’s final averaged 9.92 million viewers – an all-time high.

facts.fact: The March Madness tournament earned the NCAA more than $1 billion in revenue from ad spots that sold out across the tournament.
facts.quote: Ad spots completely sold out across the tournament, earning the NCAA more than $1 billion in revenue.

facts.fact: In the first two days of the 2023 tournament, March Madness-related content reached over 1.5 billion impressions on Twitter.
facts.quote: in just the first two days of the 2023 tournament, March Madness-related content reached over 1.5 billion impressions on Twitter.

facts.fact: Capital One's #RoadToOne campaign started in 2016.
facts.quote: The #RoadToOne campaign started back in 2016

facts.fact: Per the vendor's blog, FanDuel used #MarchMadness to caption Twitter (now X) memes in 2022, reaching 22.29 million potential impressions.
facts.quote: In 2022, FanDuel used #MarchMadness to caption Twitter (now known as X) memes relating to tournament content, reaching 22.29 million potential impressions.

facts.fact: The article states that the phrases "Final Four" and "March Madness" are officially licensed by the NCAA, so brands should avoid using them to name promotions.
facts.quote: the terms are officially licensed by the NCAA

facts.fact: Healy & Son Lawn Care LLC was founded in 2021, with roots dating back to 2016, according to its case study on the vendor's site.
facts.quote: Founded in 2021 (with roots dating back to 2016)

facts.fact: The vendor's blog post announces a holiday branded gifting deadline of November 23 for ordering branded gifts.
facts.quote: Holiday Gifting Reminder: Order Your Branded Gifts by November 23!

facts.fact: Tanworks opened the doors to its new salon on March 1, 2012, per the BPM case study (vendor's own account).
facts.quote: Tanworks opened the doors to its new salon on March 1, 2012 providing its clientele with a welcoming and warm atmosphere

facts.fact: BPM's Tanworks campaign used calls to action and promotions that the vendor says change every month, offering different deals to encourage repeat visits.
facts.quote: The calls to action and promotions vary every month providing different offers that encourage repeat visits and increase traffic to the salon.

facts.fact: Lakeland Lawn Care has been providing residential and commercial customers with lawns for over 38 years, according to the case study.
facts.quote: has been providing residential and commercial customers with beautiful, well maintained lawns for over 38 years

facts.fact: Lakeland Lawn Care serves Green Bay, Appleton, Sheboygan, Manitowoc and the Fox Valley, per the case study.
facts.quote: in the communities of Green Bay, Appleton, Sheboygan, Manitowoc and the Fox Valley

facts.fact: Greenway Station's signature feature is a 60-foot clock tower, according to the vendor's case study.
facts.quote: a signature 60-foot clock tower

facts.fact: Greenway Station is located just 10 minutes west of downtown Madison, Wisconsin, per the vendor's description.
facts.quote: Located just 10 minutes west of downtown Madison, Wis.

facts.fact: Per Baer Performance Marketing's own account, all but one of the area's major news stations reported on the 2013 Strike Out Cancer Day event after BPM's media releases.
facts.quote: all but one of the area’s major new stations reported on the 2013 SOCD

facts.fact: Strike Out Cancer Day is an annual event held during a Wisconsin Timber Rattlers baseball game, offering a free day at the ballpark for local children with cancer.
facts.quote: Strike Out Cancer Day (SOCD) is an annual event held during a Wisconsin Timber Rattlers baseball game.

facts.fact: At Strike Out Cancer Day, a portion of every ticket purchased at the gate on game day is used to provide financial assistance to local families impacted by pediatric cancer.
facts.quote: a portion of every ticket purchased at the gate on game day is used to help provide financial assistance to local families impacted by pediatric cancer

facts.fact: The Warrior Princess Mud Run combines a non-competitive 5K run with obstacles and directly benefits Harbor House Domestic Abuse Programs.
facts.quote: combines a non-competitive 5K run with fun and unique obstacles

facts.fact: SunSeekers by Rosie, a Wisconsin tanning salon chain, was first started in 1992, according to the case study.
facts.quote: Since the first SunSeekers by Rosie was started in 1992; the owner or a combination of management would place some ads here and there.

facts.fact: SunSeekers by Rosie describes itself as the largest tanning salon chain in Wisconsin.
facts.quote: SunSeekers by Rosie is the largest tanning salon chain in Wisconsin.

facts.fact: According to the SunSeekers case study, its Facebook Page was soon to welcome its 5,100th member.
facts.quote: The Facebook Page will soon welcome its 5,100th member

facts.fact: According to the SunSeekers case study, its Text Club had grown to more than 2,100 contacts.
facts.quote: SunSeekers’ Text Club has grown to include more than 2,100 contacts.

facts.fact: According to SunSeekers' General Manager Scott Nichols, the company spent anywhere from 4 to 8 hours per week on media marketing tasks such as meeting reps and reviewing proposals before its BPM relationship.
facts.quote: We would spend anywhere from 4 to 8 hours per week dealing with media marketing, meeting with reps, looking over proposals, and reading emails

facts.fact: Compirion Healthcare Solutions reports it has worked with Duke University Hospital and the Medical Center of Central Georgia.
facts.quote: Compirion has worked with some of the nation’s best systems such as Duke University Hospital and the Medical Center of Central Georgia.
